title: Growing Kingdom RTS (2$ - Android) - Fully coded by claude
author: ShekinahDesigns
selftext:
Hello everyone, God bless you.

I've created this game for Android and I'm selling it for 2, I recently released it and it has a 30% discount launch sale. 

**I'm giving away 9 keys if you are willing to test it and give constructive feedback and if possible i would love to get that feedback as a review in the store.**

I've come from a software developer background of +12 years, and I've been developing games for +5 years using unity.

I recently decided to give AI a bigger try, I've been using it to build stuff but with shared responsabilities in terms of code and checking ALL code my self, it was a longer process but it worked.. but of course it used to take a lot more to finish games, and that was fine.

Now that AI has evolved enough, I decided to give it a try, I became a "lider" and now I'm guiding the AI to what i want instead.. 

I would like to request HONEST Feedback about the game, the store, everything you can give me feedback about.

Does the game draws your attention? 

Is it fun?

And to comply with rule #4, here is how this game was made:

1: AI for planning and creating the game (I was the creative mind, but i used AI to help and refine the idea, I would say 80% of the game idea its really mine)  
2: Godot as the engine  
3: 3rd party assets for sounds and general game look (made by real people)
